mcq_drop.why: oddly worded sequence of battle phases; ambiguous ordering

patterns: APPSC asks the sides of Talikota directly, with 'Bahmani Sultanate' and Mughals as traps (answer: Deccan Sultanates).
Ruler-identification with Andhra places: Venkatapati Raya II allowed Jesuit churches at Nellore and Chandragiri.
Contemporaneity items (Raja Wodeyar - Venkata II) and year-to-battle matching (1565 = Talikota).
App goes much deeper (Toppur, Vandavasi, Nayaka founders, Rama Raya's 1546-63 diplomacy) in multi-statement form; PYQs stay single-fact.
